text_en: The word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying:
text_cn: 又有万军上主的话：

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“我以极度的妒爱，爱着熙雍，为了她我发了很大的妒恨。

text_en: Thus says the Lord : I will return to Zion, and will dwell in the midst of Jerusalem; Jerusalem shall be called the faithful city, and the mountain of the Lord of hosts shall be called the holy mountain.
text_cn: 上主这样说：我要返回熙雍，住在耶路撒冷；耶路撒冷将称为‘忠城’，万军上主的山将称为‘圣山’。”

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Old men and old women shall again sit in the streets of Jerusalem, each with staff in hand because of their great age.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“将有老夫老妇坐在耶路撒冷各街市上，每人因年高老迈，手中扶着拐杖；

text_en: And the streets of the city shall be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.
text_cn: 城里街市上，都要满了男女儿童，在街市上游戏。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Even though it seems impossible to the remnant of this people in these days, should it also seem impossible to me, says the Lord of hosts?
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：到那些时日，这事在这百姓的遗民眼中是件奇事，难道在我眼中也是件奇事吗？──万军上主的断语。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: I will save my people from the east country and from the west country;
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：看，我要由日出之地和日落之地救回我的百姓；

text_en: and I will bring them to live in Jerusalem. They shall be my people and I will be their God, in faithfulness and in righteousness.
text_cn: 我要本着忠实和正义，领他们回来，住在耶路撒冷；他们要作我的百姓，我要作他们的天主”。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Let your hands be strong—you that have recently been hearing these words from the mouths of the prophets who were present when the foundation was laid for the rebuilding of the temple, the house of the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“当建筑万军上主的殿，奠基的时日，你们由先知的口中听见这些话的人，应加强你们的手臂。

text_en: For before those days there were no wages for people or for animals, nor was there any safety from the foe for those who went out or came in, and I set them all against one another.
text_cn: 既使在这些日子以前，人得不到工资，牲畜也没有报酬，出入的人因了仇敌都得不到平安，因为我曾使人互相攻击；

text_en: But now I will not deal with the remnant of this people as in the former days, says the Lord of hosts.
text_cn: 但是现今我对待这百姓的遗民，决不像往日一样──万军上主的断语。

text_en: For there shall be a sowing of peace; the vine shall yield its fruit, the ground shall give its produce, and the skies shall give their dew; and I will cause the remnant of this people to possess all these things.
text_cn: 因为我要散播和平；葡萄树必结果实，土地必有出产，苍天必降甘露；我必要使这百姓的遗民获得这一切。

text_en: Just as you have been a cursing among the nations, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you and you shall be a blessing. Do not be afraid, but let your hands be strong.
text_cn: 犹大家和以色列家，昔日你们在异民中怎样成为可诅咒的，将来我也要照样拯救你们，使你们受人祝福；你们不要害怕，应加强你们的手臂！

text_en: For thus says the Lord of hosts: Just as I purposed to bring disaster upon you, when your ancestors provoked me to wrath, and I did not relent, says the Lord of hosts,
text_cn: 因为万军的上主这样说：就如你们的祖先惹我发怒的时候，我曾决意降罚你们──万军的上主说──而毫不动情；

text_en: so again I have purposed in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah; do not be afraid.
text_cn: 照样，在这些日子里，我也要决意善待耶路撒冷和犹大家；你们不要害怕！

text_en: These are the things that you shall do: Speak the truth to one another, render in your gates judgments that are true and make for peace,
text_cn: 你们应该遵行的训令是：彼此谈话要诚实，在城门口应作公正与和平的裁判；

text_en: do not devise evil in your hearts against one another, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate, says the Lord .
text_cn: 不可心中图谋恶事，彼此相害，也不可喜欢发假誓，因为这一切都是我所憎恶的──上主的断语。”

text_en: The word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying:
text_cn: 万军上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: The fast of the fourth month, and the fast of the fifth, and the fast of the seventh, and the fast of the tenth, shall be seasons of joy and gladness, and cheerful festivals for the house of Judah: therefore love truth and peace.
text_cn: “万军的上主这样说：四月的斋戒、五月的斋戒、七月的斋戒和十月的斋戒，为犹大家将变为愉快和喜乐以及欢跃的佳节；但你们应爱好忠实与和平”。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Peoples shall yet come, the inhabitants of many cities;
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“还有许多民族和各大城市的居民要前来；

text_en: the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, “Come, let us go to entreat the favor of the Lord , and to seek the Lord of hosts; I myself am going. ”
text_cn: 一城的居民到另一城去，向该城的居民说：我们快去恳求上主开恩，去寻求万军的上主！──我也同去。”

text_en: Many peoples and strong nations shall come to seek the Lord of hosts in Jerusalem, and to entreat the favor of the Lord .
text_cn: 将有许多民族和强盛的国民，来到耶路撒冷寻求万军的上主，恳求上主开恩。

text_en: Thus says the Lord of hosts: In those days ten men from nations of every language shall take hold of a Jew, grasping his garment and saying, “Let us go with you, for we have heard that God is with you. ”
text_cn: 万军的上主这样说：“在那些日子里，十个说异国方言的人将抓住一个犹太人的衣边说：我们要同你们一起去，因为我们听说天主同你们在一起。”
